scope: Exploratory endpoint selected after signed-gap results and movement distributions were inspected. Definition fixed before computing absolute-change hypothesis tests; not preregistered confirmation.
endpoint: For each subject, movement task and decoder, first average the Euclidean landmark errors over two test windows and three seeds for tokens and features separately. Take the absolute difference of these two errors within the cell. Finally average the eight absolute cell differences within each participant.
formula: a[s,m,d] = abs(E_token[s,m,d] - E_feature[s,m,d]); A[s,d] = mean_m a[s,m,d]
not_computed: Not absolute value of a participant-averaged signed gap, not average absolute seed-specific gaps, not a prediction-ensemble metric, and not direct distance between token and feature predictions.
contrast: D[s] = A[s,other] - A[s,Proposed]; positive means a smaller absolute error change for proposed.
null: Mean participant contrast equals zero, with joint central sign symmetry of true-null participant contrasts required for exact sign-flip inference.
test: Two-sided exact synchronized participant sign-flip single-step max-|t|; studentized participant mean differences.
replication: Nine independent participants. Keep all eight movements together within each participant; seeds, windows, time points and landmarks are not independent participants.
intervals: Exact 95% pointwise location intervals from the existing sign-flip inversion; not simultaneous and do not assign stars.
sensitivity: Report all nine leave-one-participant-out effects and record every previous adjusted-p change when extending51 to54. Do not select models, seeds, movements or participants by outcome.
interpretation: Accuracy stability under tokenization across the eight fixed tasks. Both improvements and degradations count as changes; not evidence of better overall pose accuracy or equivalence.
outputs: Separate reproducible calculation report and complete54-comparison export. Retain the original51 analysis and existing figure as explicitly prior artifacts; this request does not replace panel C.
